Sphere Bot 1.0.6

- Sign in with email and password or Google, reuse a website account on Windows and complete routing setup before opening the app.
- Manage account-synced connectors from the app or dashboard, with shared categories, provider logos, secure fields and server-managed availability.
- Use cloud computers and approved personal or team computer settings, with template build controls and reliable reconnects.
- Choose an accent, manage bot-created skills from main Settings and use the app-styled close choices.
- View local-time usage and diagnostics, with immediate quit and tray feedback.
- Explore the Sphere Bot website, approved plan features and product Privacy, Terms and Refunds policies.

Windows 10 or later, x64. The installer is per-user and unsigned. Model-provider setup and account access are required. Paid checkout is not part of this release.
